unit_attributes.statement: 29 CFR 1910.165 applies to all emergency employee alarms installed to meet a particular OSHA standard.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: The text explicitly excludes these categories from the section's scope unless intended as employee alarm systems.
unit_attributes.statement: 29 CFR 1910.165 does not apply to discharge or supervisory alarms required on various fixed extinguishing systems, or to supervisory alarms on fire suppression, alarm or detection systems, unless they are intended to be employee alarm systems.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Mandatory scope application signaled by 'shall apply'.
unit_attributes.statement: The requirements in 29 CFR 1910.165 pertaining to maintenance, testing and inspection shall apply to all local fire alarm signaling systems used for alerting employees, regardless of the other functions of the system.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Mandatory compliance signaled by 'shall meet'.
unit_attributes.statement: All pre-discharge employee alarms installed to meet a particular OSHA standard shall meet the requirements of paragraphs (b)(1) through (4), (c), and (d)(1) of 29 CFR 1910.165.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Mandatory performance requirement signaled by 'shall provide'.
unit_attributes.statement: The employee alarm system shall provide warning for necessary emergency action as called for in the emergency action plan, or for reaction time for safe escape of employees from the workplace or the immediate work area, or both.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Mandatory capability requirement signaled by 'shall be capable'.
unit_attributes.statement: The employee alarm shall be capable of being perceived above ambient noise or light levels by all employees in the affected portions of the workplace.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Discretionary permission signaled by 'may be used'.
unit_attributes.statement: Tactile devices may be used to alert those employees who would not otherwise be able to recognize the audible or visual alarm.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Mandatory requirement signaled by 'shall be'.
unit_attributes.statement: The employee alarm shall be distinctive and recognizable as a signal to evacuate the work area or to perform actions designated under the emergency action plan.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Mandatory employer duty signaled by 'shall explain'.
unit_attributes.statement: The employer shall explain to each employee the preferred means of reporting emergencies, such as manual pull box alarms, public address systems, radio or telephones.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Conditional obligation for posting telephone numbers signaled by 'shall post'.
unit_attributes.statement: When telephones serve as a means of reporting emergencies, the employer shall post emergency telephone numbers near telephones, or employee notice boards, and other conspicuous locations.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Priority mandate signaled by 'shall have priority'.
unit_attributes.statement: Where a communication system also serves as the employee alarm system, all emergency messages shall have priority over all non-emergency messages.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: General employer duty signaled by 'shall establish'.
unit_attributes.statement: The employer shall establish procedures for sounding emergency alarms in the workplace.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Conditional permission allowing direct voice communication as an acceptable procedure.
unit_attributes.statement: For employers with 10 or fewer employees in a particular workplace, direct voice communication is an acceptable procedure for sounding the alarm, provided all employees can hear the alarm.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Explicit exemption from back-up system requirements signaled by 'need not have'.
unit_attributes.statement: Workplaces of employers with 10 or fewer employees where direct voice communication is used and audible to all employees need not have a back-up system.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Mandatory duty requiring approved equipment signaled by 'shall assure'.
unit_attributes.statement: The employer shall assure that all devices, components, combinations of devices or systems constructed and installed to comply with 29 CFR 1910.165 are approved.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Factual deeming provision stating that qualifying devices are considered to meet approval requirements.
unit_attributes.statement: Steam whistles, air horns, strobe lights or similar lighting devices, or tactile devices meeting the requirements of 29 CFR 1910.165 are considered to meet the requirement for approval.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Prompt restoration obligation signaled by 'shall assure'.
unit_attributes.statement: The employer shall assure that all employee alarm systems are restored to normal operating condition as promptly as possible after each test or alarm.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Mandatory spare parts availability signaled by 'shall be available'.
unit_attributes.statement: Spare alarm devices and components subject to wear or destruction shall be available in sufficient quantities and locations for prompt restoration of the employee alarm system.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Mandatory operating condition duty with an exception signaled by 'shall assure ... except'.
unit_attributes.statement: The employer shall assure that all employee alarm systems are maintained in operating condition except when undergoing repairs or maintenance.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Bimonthly testing mandate signaled by 'shall assure'.
unit_attributes.statement: The employer shall assure that a test of the reliability and adequacy of non-supervised employee alarm systems is made every two months.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Mandatory alternating actuation device requirement signaled by 'shall be used'.
unit_attributes.statement: A different actuation device shall be used in each test of a multi-actuation device system so that no individual device is used for two consecutive tests.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Mandatory power supply maintenance obligation signaled by 'shall maintain or replace'.
unit_attributes.statement: The employer shall maintain or replace power supplies as often as is necessary to assure a fully operational condition.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Mandatory provision of back-up alarm means signaled by 'shall be provided'.
unit_attributes.statement: Back-up means of alarm, such as employee runners or telephones, shall be provided when employee alarm systems are out of service.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Mandatory supervision and notification requirement signaled by 'shall assure'.
unit_attributes.statement: The employer shall assure that employee alarm circuitry installed after January 1, 1981, which is capable of being supervised is supervised and that it will provide positive notification to assigned personnel whenever a deficiency exists in the system.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Annual testing mandate signaled by 'shall assure'.
unit_attributes.statement: The employer shall assure that all supervised employee alarm systems are tested at least annually for reliability and adequacy.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Mandatory training qualification requirement signaled by 'shall assure'.
unit_attributes.statement: The employer shall assure that the servicing, maintenance and testing of employee alarms are done by persons trained in the designed operation and functions necessary for reliable and safe operation of the system.

unit_attributes.modality_explanation: Mandatory accessibility and visibility requirement signaled by 'shall assure'.
unit_attributes.statement: The employer shall assure that manually operated actuation devices for use in conjunction with employee alarms are unobstructed, conspicuous and readily accessible.
